summary: Titan Mining Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of Richard Pozzebon as Chief Financial Officer, effective July 6, 2026. Mr. Pozzebon brings over 23 years of finance and capital markets experience, most recently as EVP and CFO of Interfor Corporation. He succeeds Interim CFO Ashley Kates, who will assist during the transition. The appointment supports Titan's strategic growth and project development in zinc concentrate and natural flake graphite. No deal terms are disclosed. The filing highlights a routine management change with no special situation implications.
